_about: PURPLE designer exam: the models of the R&D lab's model comparison. The ONE list: concept/exam/run.js --model accepts only these ids, the concept lab's Exam view shows one column per entry (in this order). Calls go through server/mubit.js (Mubit's Anthropic gateway), untrained, with the frozen designer task (concept/designer/prompt.js) and only the model id swapped. temperature: the frozen value (0) for a model that accepts it; null for a model whose API rejects a temperature setting (Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model', integrator probe 2026-10-24): the field is then left out of the request and the model runs at its default sampling. Results: concept/exam/results-base-<slug>.json (with the corrections questions: results-base-<slug>-corrections.json). max_tokens: the frozen 250 unless set here; Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 think before answering (adaptive thinking, which cannot be switched off for them) and used all 250 tokens thinking with no answer (integrator probe 2026-10-25), so they get 4000.
